OVERRIDES
  --set model="cli-model"
  --set workspace="<TMP>/other-ws"
  --set limits.max_turns="3"
  --set limits.max_tokens="500"
  --set session_dir=""
  --set output.max_schema_retries="4"
  --set prompt="summarize {{input}}"

MODEL & PROVIDER
  model:           "cli-model" (overridden via --set)
  provider type:   "openai"
  base_url:        "https://api.example.com/v1"
  request_timeout: default (120s)
  retry:           3 attempts (default), 1s initial backoff (default)

TOOLS
  workspace: "<TMP>/other-ws" (overridden via --set)
  fs builtins (fs_read, fs_write, fs_list): enabled
  shell: ENABLED (model-written command lines run via sh -c)
    allow patterns: (none)
    deny patterns:  (none)
    timeout: default (60s)
  subprocess tools:
    - "grep_logs": exec ["sh" "-c" "grep -i error /var/log/app.log"] (timeout 30s, model-supplied args: no)

REQUIREMENTS
  env:
    TEST_KEY        ✓ set
  executables:
    "sh"                      ✓ found
  env allowlists (variables the tool's process may read):
    "shell"         "TZ"
    "grep_logs"     "TZ", "LOG_DIR"

PERMISSIONS
  default policy: "allow"
  per-tool overrides:
    "fs_write": "ask"
    "ghost_tool": "deny"
  note: without a TTY, every "ask" policy is auto-denied (headless fail-safe).

BUDGETS
  max_turns:  3 (overridden via --set)
  max_tokens: 500 (overridden via --set)
  timeout:    5m0s
  max_logged_field: 8192 (default)

CONCURRENCY
  lock: enabled (a run started while another holds <config>.lock exits 7)
  tool calls in a turn: parallel (default)

OUTPUT
  schema: present (stdout carries only schema-valid JSON)
  max_schema_retries: 4 (overridden via --set)

SESSION
  session_dir: none (no audit log) (overridden via --set)

WARNINGS
  - permission entry "ghost_tool" matches no tool - typo?
  - tools.shell is enabled with no allow or deny patterns: any command the model writes will run
  - session_dir is not set: no session log (audit trail) will be written
